dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: When knowledge is condensed into written form, it is always limited by the writer's perspective and interests.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: So if we want to learn the truth of this mysterious domain, we'll just have to explore it for ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: But then again, I'm lucky that I get to do the exploring together with my cutie.
